licenseAndBuildMaterials.headerNotices: All four API headers carry ISC-style copyright/permission text. client.h says the client API is ISC; mpv core is default GPLv2+ unless built with -Dgpl=false, which makes it LGPLv2+.
licenseAndBuildMaterials.buildLicenseConfiguration: Not present in this archive; the actual -Dgpl setting and complete binary notices are unknown.

ffmpegSourceSnapshot.zipCreation: Generated with git archive from the fixed commit because the codeload HTTP request could not complete in this environment; this is a fixed local source snapshot, not GitHub's codeload ZIP.
ffmpegSourceSnapshot.codeloadAttempt: Invoke-WebRequest failed before receiving a response (HttpRequestException); the pinned commit was then fetched over Git using the OpenSSL TLS backend.
ffmpegSourceSnapshot.zipValidation: 7-Zip test passed; 10515 files, 129 directories, 93440624 uncompressed bytes.
ffmpegSourceSnapshot.relation: REFERENCE to the FFmpeg version string embedded in the DLL. The snapshot does not prove the complete linked FFmpeg tree, enabled components, or build options of the DLL.

relationship.sourceforgeArchiveRecord: Archive bytes independently downloaded and hashed; the local SHA-256 matches SourceForge's displayed checksum and the provider declaration.
relationship.mpvCommitToArchive: REFERENCE association by archive filename; no build attestation or complete dependency/build closure observed.
relationship.archiveDllToPackagedDll: EXACT byte identity established by matching SHA-256: archive member libmpv-2.dll equals the packaged mpv-1.dll hash; filename rename is consistent with byte-preserving repackaging.
relationship.mpvCommitToPackagedDll: The archive DLL carries the version v0.41.0-920-gdd5d17d32 and its bytes exactly match the packaged DLL; this ties the DLL to the stated mpv revision label but does not prove deterministic reconstruction from source.
relationship.ffmpegCommitToBinary: The fixed FFmpeg source snapshot is the exact commit named by the embedded version string; this remains a source reference, not proof of the complete linked FFmpeg source or options.
